params.label: Button text
params.description: The label. The button sizes itself to it: longer text makes a wider button, very short text keeps a minimum width, and text too wide for the frame wraps onto more lines.

params.label: First colour
params.description: One of the two colours flowing through the fill.

params.label: Second colour
params.description: The other colour flowing through the fill.

params.label: Flow cycle (s)
params.description: Time for the gradient to scroll one full cycle. Approximate: cycles are stretched or squeezed slightly so whole ones fill the clip and the button keeps moving to the last frame.

params.label: Font size (px)
params.description: Label size. The button's height follows it, and its width follows the measured text.

params.label: Vertical position (0 top / 1 bottom)
params.description: Where the button's centre sits in the frame, 0 at the top edge and 1 at the bottom.

params.label: Duration (s)
params.description: Clip length. The button enters, then idles on a loop and stays on screen to the end.
